zh.title: 订单已经下了，AI 员工却只看见超时：该重试吗？
zh.summary: 服务端已经下单，AI 员工却只收到超时。我们在三个断点杀掉进程，并用无幂等键的盲重试作对照，寻找恢复时真正可信的证据。

en.title: The order went through. The AI worker saw only a timeout. Should it retry?
en.summary: The business system committed an order while the AI worker saw a timeout. We killed a process at three boundaries and used a blind retry without an idempotency key as a control.
